provenance: Labels and layout numbers chosen by the author of the work-ugs-audit skill (plan 7, spec 2026-11-16) and to be reviewed by the owner. The wording is data (R6): a label is shown in the language of the report only, and a missing key is a named error (R3).

layout.provenance: Chosen by the author on 2026-11-16 for an A4 page; checked on fictitious PDFs by Test/test_annex_layout.py, which reads word boxes against this margin. The comment column takes the width the three fixed columns leave. The two values after page_margin were measured on the same fixtures on 2026-11-17: a story run of 300 unbroken characters overflowed the comment column unless split, and the first line of a row continued on the next page started 2.6 points above the content box.

fr.provenance: French wording chosen by the author, to be reviewed by the owner. The check, numbering and excluded-page wording was added on 2026-11-17 (Issue 122, plan 8), with the same status.

fr.citation_comment: Appel numérique placé après le point de la phrase : placer la citation avant le point.

title_placement_comments.figure_misplaced: Titre de figure mal placé : le centrer sous la figure.
title_placement_comments.table_misplaced: Titre de tableau mal placé : l'aligner à gauche au-dessus du tableau.
title_placement_comments.in_image: Titre inclus dans l'image : l'écrire dans le texte du document, sous la figure (ou au-dessus du tableau).

title_kind_comments.figure_titled_table: Titre incorrect : cet élément est une figure, pas un tableau. Utiliser « Figure N » et l'inscrire dans la liste des figures.

en.title: Completed rubric
en.all_elements_present: Every element of the rubric is present.

validation_values.timeout: The model did not answer in time
validation_values.not_applicable_not_allowed: Not applicable refused: item not optional
validation_values.no_fit: Text too long for the model window
validation_values.elements_missing: No element named: the model did not list the elements the item asks for
validation_values.not_applicable_with_score: Not applicable with a score or evidence: the answer must carry neither
validation_values.elements_mismatch: Elements that do not match the rubric: one verdict per id, and only those
validation_values.comment_scope: Comment on the whole report: sentence removed, the comment speaks of the section
validation_values.elements_too_few: Too few elements named: the answer lists fewer elements than the rubric asks for

check_values.figure_counts: Number of figures: declared and extracted
check_values.table_counts: Number of tables: declared and extracted
check_values.untitled_elements: Elements without a title (unlabelled figures or tables)
check_values.title_kind: Title matches the element type (figure or table)
check_values.title_placement: Titles placed by the rule (figure: centered below; table: left-aligned above)

en.citation_comment: Numeric citation placed after the period of the sentence: place the citation before the period.

title_placement_comments.figure_misplaced: Figure title misplaced: center it below the figure.
title_placement_comments.table_misplaced: Table title misplaced: left-align it above the table.
title_placement_comments.in_image: Title drawn inside the image: write it in the document text, below the figure (or above the table).

title_kind_comments.table_titled_figure: Wrong title: this element is a table, not a figure. Use "Table N" and add it to the list of tables.
title_kind_comments.figure_titled_table: Wrong title: this element is a figure, not a table. Use "Figure N" and add it to the list of figures.
